Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.overview: Bernardo Faria's top control and low-risk submissions for older grapplers, five volumes, each a 'phase' built around one position: side control, knee on belly, mount, the back, and top half guard. For each, he shows how to make the position uncomfortable with aggressive pressure fixes and then finish with simple submissions that don't need speed (Bernardo is well known for using the ezekiel choke and similar 'sneaky' attacks).
Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.for: Older or less athletic gi players who want heavy, safe top control.

Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.overview: Bernardo Faria's over-under pressure passing system, four volumes, designed to need no speed or athleticism. Volume 1 covers the three-part approach. Volume 2 covers how to approach from De La Riva guard and from closed guard. Volume 3 covers passing with the over-under, including against constant hip escapes. Volume 4 covers controlling the head after the pass and what to do when they frame.
Jiu Jitsu For Old Guys Bundle By Bernard.for: Gi players of any age who want one reliable pressure pass.
key: Approaching from De La Riva and closed guard
